cover-tet-banner-street.source_alt: Lively street scene with festive decor for Lunar New Year in Hanoi, Vietnam.
cover-tet-banner-street.seen: Banner Chuc Mung Nam Moi - Happy New Year, red lanterns, potted peach trees, old yellow apartment block. Street sign reads Ngo 437 duong Ngoc Lam (Long Bien), so not the Old Quarter. Small national and Party flags on a string. Two people at the right edge.

peach-trees-motorbikes.source_alt: Motorbikes carrying cherry blossom trees on a street, capturing the essence of springtime transport.
peach-trees-motorbikes.seen: Peach trees tied to parked motorbikes along a tree-lined street; one man from behind. Three readable licence plates with prefix 29 (Hanoi): blur or crop before publishing.

nhat-tan-peach-blossom.seen: Peach tree in full pink bloom, no people
